clips.title: The story
paras: Mountaineer Stormpike sends a written commission from Loch Modan to Stormwind City. He asks Furen Longbeard to craft him a shield of exceptional dwarven quality.

Mountaineer Stormpike needs a sturdy shield while stationed in Loch Modan. He trusts no ordinary smith with the work and asks Furen Longbeard, whose craft he greatly admires. Furen now lives among the humans in Stormwind's Dwarven District, having left Ironforge. Stormpike assumes a king's ransom drew him south, so traveling adventurers carry the commission across the kingdoms.

Furen Longbeard receives Stormpike's letter in Stormwind's Dwarven District and agrees to make the shield. A proud and established member of the Stormpike clan, known across Khaz Modan for its martial grit and wealth, Furen welcomes word and business from his northern homeland. He sets to work on the mountaineer's order.
